messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Got up this morning ( okay it was so the afternoon )... hung here around the house... showered up, went and got my nails done, then headed to St. Pete.

output.original_text: Got up this morning ( okay it was so the afternoon )... hung here around the house... showered up, went and got my nails done, then headed to St. Pete.
output.joy: I woke up this morning (well, technically it was the afternoon!) and spent a lovely time around the house... took a refreshing shower, got my nails done, and then joyfully headed to St. Pete!
output.sadness: I got up this morning (more like the afternoon)... just sat around the house... showered up, got my nails done, and then reluctantly went to St. Pete.
output.fear: I woke up this morning (okay, it was in the afternoon)... just hung around the house nervously... showered, got my nails done, and then cautiously headed to St. Pete.
output.anger: I got up this morning (fine, it was the afternoon!) and just hung around the house... I took a shower, got my nails done, and then stormed off to St. Pete.
output.surprise: I woke up this morning (can you believe it? It was actually the afternoon!) and unexpectedly hung around the house... showered, went and got my nails done, then surprisingly headed to St. Pete.
output.disgust: I got up this morning (ugh, more like the afternoon)... just hung around this messy place... showered, got my nails done, then headed to St. Pete, which just feels so tiresome.
